items.zh: 快递业的发展改变了中国人的购物方式。如今，许多农村地区也能在两天内收到包裹。快递员成为城市中熟悉的面孔。
items.en: The growth of the express delivery industry has changed the way Chinese people shop. Today, many rural areas can receive parcels within two days. Delivery workers have become a familiar sight in cities.
tip: the way ... shop 后接定语从句，省略了 in which
parcel 包裹，比 package 更常用于邮寄语境
a familiar sight 熟悉的面孔／景象

items.zh: 外卖服务在中国非常普遍。人们用手机下单，半小时内就能收到热饭。外卖也给餐饮业带来了新的机会和挑战。
items.en: Food delivery is very common in China. People place orders on their phones and receive a hot meal within half an hour. Delivery services have also brought new opportunities and challenges to the restaurant industry.
tip: 「外卖」food delivery；「外卖员」delivery rider
within half an hour 表时间范围
bring opportunities and challenges to 为常见搭配

items.zh: 近年来，马拉松在中国越来越受欢迎。许多城市每年举办比赛，吸引数万名跑者参加。跑步逐渐成为一种健康的生活方式。
items.en: In recent years, marathons have become increasingly popular in China. Many cities hold races every year, attracting tens of thousands of runners. Running has gradually become a healthy lifestyle.
tip: attracting ... 现在分词作结果状语
hold a race 举办比赛
increasingly popular 越来越受欢迎

items.zh: 剪纸是中国古老的民间艺术。人们用剪刀在红纸上剪出花鸟和人物。每逢春节，许多家庭会把剪纸贴在窗户上。
items.en: Paper-cutting is an ancient folk art in China. People use scissors to cut flowers, birds and figures out of red paper. During the Spring Festival, many families paste paper-cuts on their windows.
tip: cut A out of B 从 B 中剪出 A
figure 在此指人物
paper-cut 作名词，paper-cutting 指这门技艺

items.zh: 丝绸是中国对世界的重要贡献。两千多年前，中国丝绸通过丝绸之路运往西方。今天，丝绸仍然是受欢迎的高档面料。
items.en: Silk is an important contribution China has made to the world. More than 2,000 years ago, Chinese silk was carried to the West along the Silk Road. Today, silk remains a popular luxury fabric.
tip: China has made 为省略 that 的定语从句
along the Silk Road 沿丝绸之路
luxury fabric 高档面料

items.zh: 瓷器在中国已有上千年的历史。景德镇被称为瓷都，那里的工匠至今仍用手工绘制图案。精美的瓷器被出口到世界各地。
items.en: Porcelain has a history of more than a thousand years in China. Jingdezhen is known as the porcelain capital, where craftsmen still paint patterns by hand. Exquisite porcelain is exported all over the world.
tip: be known as 被称为，as 后接身份
where 引导非限制性定语从句
exquisite 精美的，比 beautiful 精确

items.zh: 苏州园林是中国古典园林的代表。园林中的假山、水池和亭子相互映衬，营造出宁静的氛围。每年有大量游客前来参观。
items.en: Suzhou gardens are representative of classical Chinese gardens. The rockeries, ponds and pavilions set each other off, creating a peaceful atmosphere. Every year a large number of tourists come to visit.
tip: set each other off 相互映衬，为固定搭配
creating ... 现在分词作结果状语
rockery 假山，pavilion 亭子

items.zh: 故宫是中国最大的古代宫殿建筑群。它曾经是明清两代的皇宫，如今成为一座博物馆。游客可以在这里了解中国的历史与文化。
items.en: The Palace Museum is the largest complex of ancient palace buildings in China. It used to be the imperial palace of the Ming and Qing dynasties and is now a museum. Visitors can learn about Chinese history and culture there.
tip: the Palace Museum 故宫的官方英文名
used to be 过去曾是，注意与 be used to 区分
complex 建筑群，作名词

items.zh: 二十四节气是中国古人根据气候变化总结出的时间体系。它指导农业生产，也影响着人们的饮食和习俗。2016 年，它被列入联合国非物质文化遗产名录。
items.en: The 24 solar terms are a time system that ancient Chinese people developed from changes in climate. They guide farming and also influence people's diet and customs. In 2016, they were added to the UN list of intangible cultural heritage.
tip: solar term 节气，为固定译法
that 引导定语从句，先行词是 system
be added to the list 被列入名录

items.zh: 中秋节是家人团聚的日子。人们在这一天赏月、吃月饼。月饼圆圆的形状象征着团圆和美满。
items.en: The Mid-Autumn Festival is a day for family reunions. People admire the moon and eat mooncakes on this day. The round shape of the mooncake symbolises reunion and happiness.
tip: admire the moon 赏月，动词不用 enjoy
symbolise 象征，英式拼写
a day for ... 表用途

items.zh: 端午节在农历五月初五。人们吃粽子、赛龙舟，纪念古代诗人屈原。这一节日已被列入法定假日。
items.en: The Dragon Boat Festival falls on the fifth day of the fifth lunar month. People eat zongzi and hold dragon boat races in memory of the ancient poet Qu Yuan. The festival has been made a public holiday.
tip: fall on 用于日期，主语是节日
in memory of 纪念
be made a public holiday 被定为法定假日

items.zh: 火锅是中国很受欢迎的一种饮食方式。人们把肉和蔬菜放进滚烫的汤里煮熟，再蘸调料食用。吃火锅也是朋友聚会的好机会。
items.en: Hotpot is a popular way of eating in China. People boil meat and vegetables in bubbling soup and then dip them in sauce. Eating hotpot is also a good chance for friends to get together.
tip: boil 煮，dip 蘸，两个动词按顺序排列
bubbling soup 滚烫的汤
a chance for sb to do

items.zh: 许多中国大学鼓励学生参加社会实践。学生可以利用假期到企业实习，或到农村支教。这些经历帮助他们更好地了解社会。
items.en: Many Chinese universities encourage students to take part in social practice. Students can do internships in companies or teach in rural schools during holidays. These experiences help them understand society better.
tip: encourage sb to do
do an internship 实习，不用 join
help sb do sth，better 置于句末

items.zh: 城市漫步成为年轻人喜爱的一种休闲方式。他们不设目的地，在街上慢慢走，观察建筑和店铺。这种方式让人重新发现身边的城市。
items.en: City walks have become a popular form of leisure among young people. They walk slowly along the streets without a destination, observing buildings and shops. This way of travelling helps people rediscover the city around them.
tip: without a destination 无目的地，作状语
observing ... 现在分词表伴随
rediscover 重新发现，前缀 re- 表再次

items.zh: 宠物经济在中国快速增长。越来越多的家庭养猫养狗，愿意为宠物购买食品、玩具和医疗服务。相关产业因此迅速扩大。
items.en: The pet economy is growing rapidly in China. More and more families keep cats and dogs and are willing to buy food, toys and medical services for them. Related industries have therefore expanded quickly.
tip: be willing to do 愿意做
for them 指宠物，代词位置在句末
expand 扩大，与 industry 搭配

items.zh: 夜间经济为城市带来了新的活力。许多商场和小吃街营业到深夜，年轻人下班后仍有地方消费和放松。
items.en: The night-time economy has brought new vitality to cities. Many shopping malls and snack streets stay open late into the night, so young people still have places to spend money and relax after work.
tip: stay open 保持营业，open 为形容词
late into the night 直到深夜
so 引导结果状语从句

items.zh: 北京冬奥会之后，冰雪运动在中国迅速普及。越来越多的南方城市建起了室内滑雪场，孩子们也有机会学习滑冰。
items.en: After the Beijing Winter Olympics, winter sports spread rapidly in China. More and more southern cities have built indoor ski resorts, and children now have the chance to learn skating.
tip: Winter Olympics 冬奥会，首字母大写
indoor ski resort 室内滑雪场
have the chance to do

items.zh: 无障碍设施的建设体现了一座城市的文明程度。坡道、盲道和电梯让老年人和残障人士出行更加方便。
items.en: The construction of barrier-free facilities reflects the civility of a city. Ramps, tactile paths and lifts make it easier for elderly people and people with disabilities to get around.
tip: barrier-free facilities 无障碍设施
make it easier for sb to do，it 为形式宾语
get around 出行，比 travel 更口语

items.zh: 人工智能正在进入中国人的日常生活。它可以帮人写邮件、翻译文章，也能辅助医生诊断疾病。人们既期待它带来的便利，也担心隐私问题。
items.en: Artificial intelligence is entering the daily life of Chinese people. It can help people write emails and translate articles, and it can also assist doctors in diagnosing diseases. People look forward to the convenience it brings but also worry about privacy.
tip: assist sb in doing 协助某人做某事
look forward to 后接名词或动名词
the convenience it brings 省略 that 的定语从句

items.zh: 越来越多的年轻人回到家乡创业。他们开网店、做直播，把当地的农产品卖到全国各地。这为乡村振兴注入了新的动力。
items.en: More and more young people are returning to their hometowns to start businesses. They open online shops and livestream, selling local farm produce across the country. This has injected new energy into rural revitalisation.
tip: start a business 创业
livestream 作动词，直播
inject ... into 为比喻用法，乡村振兴固定译 rural revitalisation

items.zh: 新能源汽车在中国街头越来越常见。充电桩的数量不断增加，续航里程也在提高。政府提供补贴，鼓励人们购买环保汽车。
items.en: New energy vehicles are becoming increasingly common on Chinese streets. The number of charging piles keeps growing, and driving ranges are improving. The government offers subsidies to encourage people to buy green cars.
tip: new energy vehicle 新能源汽车，缩写 NEV
charging pile 充电桩，driving range 续航里程
subsidy 补贴，可数名词

items.zh: 博物馆的文创产品受到年轻人欢迎。它们把文物元素融入日常用品，让历史走进生活。一些热门产品常常一上架就售罄。
items.en: Cultural products from museums are popular with young people. They integrate elements of cultural relics into everyday objects, bringing history into daily life. Some popular items sell out as soon as they hit the shelves.
tip: be popular with 受……欢迎，不用 by
integrate A into B 把 A 融入 B
sell out 售罄，as soon as 引导时间状语从句
